def trigger(self, item):
        item.iteration_cooldown = self.adjust_cooldown(item)
        item.trigger_time += item.iteration_cooldown
        char = self.characters[item.side]
        if item.item_index == 385:
            self.give_least_buffs(item, item.definition["least_buffs"])
            self.activate(item)
            return
        if item.item_index == 162:
            self._bowl_cooldown_effect(item)
            return
        if item.item_index in BOWL_PET_IDS:
            self._validate_bowl_double_activation_chance(item)
            self._pet_cooldown_effect(item)
            # The complete first effect, including Squirrel pitch, has returned.
            if item.double_activation_chance > 0.0 and self.random.randf(
                    "double_activation:" + item.instance_id) <= item.double_activation_chance:
                self._pet_cooldown_effect(item)
            return
        if item.item_index == 50:
            self.health_to_block(item,item.definition["health_cost"],item.definition["converted_block"])
